slice: Daily Work + Action Inbox anchor polish
intent: Continue the Bominal-grade cohesive Oyatie dashboard by upgrading Daily Work, Execution Queue, Schedule, and Action Inbox into FD-001/Oyatie Cloud execution command proof surfaces with SSR parity.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added dynamic and SSR-static proof boards for Daily Work and Action Inbox using the existing proof-card design language.
Added Execution Queue and Schedule subroute footers so direct anchors carry FD-001, Oyatie Cloud, and local-only/no-mutation proof copy.

Added data-daily-proof-action interactions for routes to Action Inbox, Daily Execution, Schedule, Workflow, Oyatie Cloud, Policy, Audit, Evidence, Mail, Messenger, and Community, plus local packet staging.
Added responsive daily-proof CSS and active/selected visual states without introducing a new design-system layer.

visual_verdict.category_match: Cohesive FD-001/Oyatie Cloud execution command dashboard
visual_verdict.reasoning: Daily Work and Action Inbox no longer read as generic task widgets. They now explain why tasks, approvals, schedule pressure, built-in comms, workflow routes, and evidence are FD-001 tenant workload proof, and they visibly route into the substrate/policy/audit surfaces while preserving local-only constraints.
differences: The added proof boards increase vertical height; pixel diffs are expected content additions rather than regressions.
Backend services remain intentionally disconnected because this is a visual prototype.
suggestions: Continue with remaining sparse direct anchors such as FinOps, resource inventory, and evidence ledger.
Eventually consolidate repeated proof-board CSS once all sections converge on the same reusable pattern.

commands.summary: ready-after-3s; transient empty replies after restart

known_limits: Visual prototype only; no backend writes, auth changes, workflow execution, mail sends, payroll, billing, policy, or cloud mutations are wired.
This slice improves Daily Work and Action Inbox; it does not prove the full dashboard/mockup objective complete.
